digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend adapter hardening
propositions: Epic-field contract validation must occur post-run and exit non-zero when capability cannot be verified, preventing silent writes of incorrect Epic-field reports.

Capability call sites must be runtime-guarded using isinstance-primary with hasattr fallback logic to handle proxy transports, with distinct reporting of capability-absent versus capability-raised errors on the bridge_alerts channel rather than silent failures.
The dormant inbound absence-probe port including SupportsAbsenceProbe interface, classify_probe_response classifier, and probe_remote implementations must be completely deleted.
Three unit test modules (test_probe_capability.py and siblings) exercising only the deleted probe port are removed as part of the pure deletion with no assertion weakening.
Pre-existing live DC harness failures attributed to commit c87afedba8 are not regressions from this epic's three changes (f487b62b3c, 671fa77c88, b95c097fd4) which landed after the failures occurred.
